description: Multi-session status view in the cockpit. Show session busy/idle plus context size, open jobs plus running time, the owner question queue, disk free plus hourly spend, and the ledger tail, fitted to the Sessions tab, Ops strip and mobile /m view. Must reuse the SmartMemory status TUI data readers (sm_status.py, owner_queue.py), not write a second set. Decided 2026-10-30 (owner): stratum session JSON + sm_status.py --json + Cadence belt/shadow, read-only v1.
phase: COMP-COCKPIT Wave 2: UX Journey Gaps (2026-06-10 sweep)
